title: Decode ResourceSearchResponse by actual ResultFormat, not requested one
answers: How do I handle a ResourceSearchRequest that asks for FIELD_VALUES?
Why does my search response sometimes come back as a ResourceTable even though I requested FIELD_VALUES?
Backward compatibility with older unified-storage/search servers
Folder migration validation failing or misreading parent folder on mixed-version clusters
body:
Symptom: code that requests ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES and unconditionally parses response.Rows/Fields can silently misread or crash when talking to an older search server that ignores ResultFormat and still returns the legacy Results ResourceTable.
Root cause: a search server's actual response format can differ from the request's ResultFormat; callers must not assume the request was honored (pkg/storage/unified/migrations/validator.go:decodeFolderParentMap).
Fix pattern: switch on response.GetResultFormat() (UNSPECIFIED/RESOURCE_TABLE vs FIELD_VALUES) and decode each branch with its own logic; for FIELD_VALUES use resource.DecodeSearchValues(response.GetFields(), row) per row and type-assert the field value.
Constraints: applies to any caller of ResourceClient.Search that sets ResultFormat; always check searchResp.GetError() before decoding, and treat a nil Results/Rows as empty rather than erroring.
applies: Any code consuming resourcepb.ResourceSearchResponse after setting ResultFormat on the request (unified storage search clients).

search: Decode ResourceSearchResponse by checking response.GetResultFormat(), not the requested format, to handle servers that ignore ResultFormat and return legacy responses. During version skew, a search server's actual response format can differ from the request's ResultFormat; code that unconditionally parses response.Rows/Fields can silently misread or crash. The fix pattern is to switch on response.GetResultFormat() (UNSPECIFIED/RESOURCE_TABLE vs FIELD_VALUES), decode each branch with its own logic, and use resource.DecodeSearchValues(response.GetFields(), row) for FIELD_VALUES. Always check searchResp.GetError() before decoding and treat nil Results/Rows as empty. This applies to any caller of ResourceClient.Search that sets ResultFormat, as shown in pkg/storage/unified/migrations/validator.go:decodeFolderParentMap.
